newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesian-linked Singapore stocks gain on poll.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian-linked Singapore stocks gain on poll.

text.p: Shares in Singapore-listed companies with prominent Indonesian shareholders gained on Friday as Indonesia's Golkar ruling party headed for a landslide general election win.

Infrastructure company L&M Group, timber group United Pulp & Paper (UPP), engineering firm Van der Horst Ltd (VDH) and foods group ABR Holdings all featured among the most active gainers in the first hour of trade.
"The election is the only obvious explanation for this," said one Singaporean dealer.
With more than half the votes counted on Friday morning, Golkar had won nearly 74 percent of the them.
By 0200 GMT, L&M was up three cents at Singapore $1.58, UPP was up three cents at S$1.38, VDH was up four cents at S$4.04 while ABR was up three cents at S$1.21.
All four companies are linked to Indonesian tycoons who have been associated with the Jakarta establishment.
